Description.English: Under the influence of a strong northeast monsoon, winds in Macao are expected to reach force 6 with gusts, and temperature will drop significantly. The minimum temperature will be around 16 degrees Celsius on Thursday (19th Nov), and will drop further to 14 degrees on Friday (20th Nov). As the skies will be cloudy with some light rain patches, the apparent temperature will be lower than the actual temperature. The public is advised to pay attention to the weather changes and take precautions to stay warm.( Update Time: 2026-11-19 00H10 )
